description: Resolve a company domain to its Pinterest business account and return EXACT follower, following, pin and board counts, plus the claimed website, verified merchant status and last pin date, as one flat Clay ready row. Pinterest serves real integers, so these counts can be summed across a list. Board count is a better activity signal than followers for a consumer brand, because boards are curation effort. Pinterest handles are rarely the domain stem, so a guessed account that fails the identity check is reported as identity_mismatch with no counts rather than returning a stranger's numbers. Read only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Bare company domain, for example shopify.com. Supply this or a handle. With a domain the actor runs full discovery; with a handle it skips straight to the fetch.

company_name.description: Optional. Improves search accuracy and is what the identity gate checks a discovered profile against, so supplying it reduces wrong matches.

handle.description: Optional. The Pinterest username from pinterest.com/<handle>. Supplying it skips discovery and, more importantly, skips the identity risk: Pinterest handles are rarely the domain stem.

includeFollowerCounts.description: Default true: the profile page is fetched and the follower counts are extracted. Set false to resolve the profile URL only, which is cheaper and needs no proxy.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

skipCache.description: Default false: a successful lookup is cached for seven days and reused. Set true to force a fresh fetch.
